details: Approved final bright Pearl Rose Ultra concept replaces previous Chef Signature theme. One pearl-rose.css mobile stylesheet + one lightweight pearl-rose-ui.js; one pearl-rose-workspace.css for studio on top of required functional TTK/A4 core CSS only. Header, realistic sushi hero, blossom SVG, ruby CTA, four live counters, asymmetrical Create TTK / Catalog / PDF cards, continuation and 5-tab dock. Four optimized WebP crops of original approved mockup, no baked-in button text, all live TTK/PDF/projects/cloud routes retained, seven catalog/history actions remain marked 'soon'. No signed APK built, no 8K raster claim, in-app Xiaomi verification pending.
